_doc: Bench for the simulated cam07 data (sim/simulate.py). 'today' = 2026-10-09, 'yesterday' = 2026-10-08, both 10:00-10:10. Truth comes from the simulator ground truth, not from the derived tables. Grade with bench/run_bench.py (LLM judge with these rubrics) and review transcripts. Add real supervisor questions with hand-labelled truth as soon as real data exists.

questions.q: How many people were in view of cam07 at 10:03 today?
questions.truth: 7 people (4 operators + 3 visitors at the control panel).
questions.rubric: 2 = says 7. 1 = says 6 or 8 with a caveat about counting in crowds. 0 = other number or no number.

questions.q: Was Op 15 manned between 10:04 and 10:07 today?
questions.truth: No. Op 15 was empty from about 10:03:20 to 10:07:40; the camera was offline 10:05:45-10:06:25 so that part is unknown.
questions.rubric: 2 = clear no AND mentions the offline/unknown part. 1 = clear no without the offline caveat. 0 = yes or unclear.

questions.q: Which operator stations were empty for more than a minute today between 10:00 and 10:10, and when?
questions.truth: Only Op 15, about 10:03:20-10:07:41 (offline gap inside). Op 14, 16, 17 only had short bench step-aways.
questions.rubric: 2 = only Op 15 with times within 60 s. 1 = Op 15 right but times off or an extra station listed with a caveat. 0 = misses Op 15 or lists extra stations as fact.

questions.q: How many times did someone enter the camera view today, and from which side?
questions.truth: 5 entries: 3 from the east exit (about 10:02:08-10:02:17, a group) and 2 from the west exit (about 10:06:44 and 10:08:41).
questions.rubric: 2 = 5 entries with east 3 / west 2. 1 = total or split off by one, with a reliability caveat. 0 = otherwise.

questions.q: Was the cam07 camera working the whole time today between 10:00 and 10:10?
questions.rubric: 2 = offline with the right times. 1 = offline, times wrong. 0 = says working the whole time.

questions.q: Is the person working at Op 15 at 10:09 today the same person who worked there at 10:01?
questions.truth: Different person in the simulation (the first left west at 10:03:56; another entered from the west at 10:06:44). The data cannot prove identity.
questions.rubric: 2 = says it cannot be confirmed from tracking (unknown), mentions the exit and the later entry, and/or checks frames and reports a visible difference with stated uncertainty. 1 = unknown without explanation. 0 = says 'same person' as fact.

questions.q: Did anyone run on the floor today?
questions.truth: Yes. One person moved fast along the yellow aisle from west to east at about 10:08:41-10:08:46.
questions.rubric: 2 = yes with time ±10 s and aisle/direction. 1 = yes, time or place missing. 0 = no.

questions.q: Was there any crowding today? Where and when?
questions.truth: Yes. 3 visitors stood together at the control panel front from about 10:02:37 to 10:05:10 (they came in from the east). Also 4 people around Op 16/17 just after the camera came back online (about 10:06:25-10:07:00).
questions.rubric: 2 = control panel crowd with times within 60 s (Op 16/17 mention optional). 1 = crowd found but place or time wrong. 0 = no crowd.

questions.q: Was anyone sleeping on the floor yesterday?
questions.truth: One person stood still on open floor near the notice board from about 10:02:14 to 10:06:40 (outside work areas). The simulated frames show a standing figure. Sleeping is NOT supported.
questions.rubric: 2 = reports the long stationary person near the notice board with times AND does not claim sleep as fact (checks frames or says it cannot be confirmed). 1 = finds it but claims sleep, or no times. 0 = misses it.

questions.q: When was Op 14 empty yesterday, and where did the person go?
questions.truth: Op 14 empty about 10:01:42-10:04:24. A person left via the bench/passage to the yellow aisle and out of view at the east exit about 10:02:41; someone came back from the east about 10:03:48 and reached Op 14 about 10:04:24. Identity of the returning person cannot be proven.
questions.rubric: 2 = empty interval within 60 s AND the exit east path. 1 = only one of the two. 0 = neither.

questions.q: Compare cam07 today vs yesterday (10:00-10:10). Was it busier? What changed?
questions.truth: Slightly busier today: average about 5.1 vs 4.8-4.9 people, peak 7 vs 6. Today: Op 15 empty ~4 min, visitors/crowding at the control panel, a runner, 40 s offline. Yesterday: Op 14 empty ~2.7 min, Op 16 empty ~1.2 min, a person standing still near the notice board ~4.5 min.
questions.rubric: 2 = correct direction with numbers AND at least 2 correct differences. 1 = direction right, differences thin or partly wrong. 0 = wrong direction or invented differences.

questions.q: Did the operators at Press 16 and Press 17 chat yesterday?
questions.truth: Two people stood close together at Op 17 from about 10:08:05 to 10:09:17 (Op 16 was empty then). Distance only: a conversation is possible but not proven.
questions.rubric: 2 = reports the close pair at Op 17 with times AND says it is distance-only (not proof of talking). 1 = finds it but claims chatting as fact. 0 = misses it.

questions.q: Where did people spend time outside their work stations yesterday?
questions.truth: Mainly on open floor between Bench R's right end and the notice board (about 4.5 min, one person standing still), plus walking in the aisle and passage.
questions.rubric: 2 = names the notice-board / right-of-Bench-R spot with about 4-5 min. 1 = names it without amount or with a wrong amount. 0 = misses it.

questions.q: Where exactly was the person at Press 15 standing at 10:01:30 yesterday?
questions.truth: In Op 15, between Press 15 and Bench L (press side of the bench), about 0.5 bh from each.
questions.rubric: 2 = between Press 15 and Bench L / press side of the bench. 1 = 'at Op 15' without relation. 0 = wrong side or invented.

questions.q: What was the Press 15 operator doing at 10:05 today?
questions.truth: Unknown: Op 15 was empty; the person who had been there left the view at the west exit at 10:03:56.
questions.rubric: 2 = says station empty / person not in view / activity unknown. 1 = says absent but guesses a reason. 0 = states an activity.

questions.q: How many different people appeared on cam07 today between 10:00 and 10:10?
questions.truth: 9 in the simulation. The data gives bounds (at least 7, at most 9); identity is not tracked.
questions.rubric: 2 = gives a range that contains 9 with an explanation (or 9 with a caveat). 1 = range containing 9 without explanation. 0 = a single wrong number stated as fact.
